expected_behavior: Flags that omnigent/db/utils.py is already over 1,000 lines (1,527 on main, 1,627 after) and that the PR adds a separate responsibility to it: sqlite_database_path and backup_sqlite_database locate the file behind a URL, check free space, create the copy with the source's mode, run SQLite's backup API, and prune old copies, none of which touches an engine or a session. Asks for that code to live in its own module, for example omnigent/db/sqlite_backup.py beside cockroachdb.py and compression.py, called from _initialize_or_verify_schema.
